I am old now, 77 years, and this small piece of land is not even mine — I rent it. My maize plot is very small, just a corner really, and I plant beans together with the maize like I always do. I have no money for the chemical fertilizer this year because I did not get the coupon, and one bag is too much for my little plot anyway. I will put the small manure I gather from my goats, use the seed I saved from last harvest, and weed with my own hands as my body allows.
